outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial transcriptomics tissue image with cluster-colored spots overlaid on the section; it is a spatial map/micrograph, not a bar/summary plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B shows H&E histology images with manual region annotations, a micrograph/photograph type, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C includes H&E images alongside spatial gene-expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue; heatmap-type visualizations are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment line plots (running enrichment score curves); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Panel E is a bar graph of log2 fold-change values for individual genes derived from differential expression analysis across spots; it shows only summary bars with p-values and does not overlay the underlying individual data points/spot-level values.
